answer_1.quote: Given a text input x, our system generates a sequence of expression vectors ψ = {E 0 , E 1 , ..., E T } over T time steps.

answer_2.quote: To evaluate this, we adopt several evaluation metrics from prior studies and introduce additional fine-grained evaluation criteria. Diversity measures the diversity of generated sequences without text as conditions ... Multimodality (abbreviated as MModality) measures the diversity of text-conditioned results ... Variation measures the diversity of a sequence as it changes over time ... Fine-grained Diversity (abbreviated as FgD) quantifies the subtle temporal fluctuations ... Diversity on Test (abbreviated as DoT) measures the diversity ... Continuous perplexity (abbreviated as Cppl) evaluates how naturally an expression sequence evolves over time ...

answer_4.quote: Due to the absence of precise automatic tools to evaluate this alignment, we rely on human evaluation following. Each sample is rendered as an avatar video at 24 frames per second and shown to five participants. The participants are instructed to rank the outputs based on the emotional consistency between the facial expressions and the corresponding text.
answer_4.guideline: Participants rank outputs based on emotional consistency between facial expressions and input text.
